introduction: A broadcast visits each connected client. Only open sockets are ready to send.
learningObjectives: Send to connected clients with WebSockets

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Send to connected clients

blocks.text: The server loops over connected open peers and sends the news message to each, including this client.
Change the message sent by the client.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A disconnected socket is not ready for a send.
